easy.statement_latex: State the domain of $f(x) = \dfrac{6}{x}$ in interval notation.
hints: A rational function is undefined wherever its denominator is zero.
Set the denominator equal to zero and solve for $x$.
Exclude that value from the real numbers.
solution_steps_latex: Set the denominator equal to zero: $x = 0$, giving $x = 0$.
This is the only value where $f$ is undefined.
The domain is all real numbers except $x = 0$: $(-\infty, 0) \cup (0, \infty)$ (or equivalently $\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x \ne 0\}$).
